result.description: Enterprise ecommerce platform (B2C Commerce) with headless Shopper and Admin APIs (SCAPI) plus legacy OCAPI for storefront and back-office automation.
result.auth_detail: SCAPI Shopper APIs: OAuth2 via SLAS (Shopper Login), public/private clients, JWT access tokens (~30 min). SCAPI Admin APIs: OAuth2 client credentials from an Account Manager API client (oauth2/access_token). Based on Salesforce doc search summaries; docs pages returned 403 to the fetcher, so not verbatim-verified.
result.access_detail: Credentials (SLAS client, Account Manager API client) only exist within an existing B2C Commerce tenant/instance (sandbox or realm) that a customer or partner provisions. No public self-serve signup found. The official MCP page says connected tasks need an instance hostname and Account Manager sign-in. Could not fetch the getting-started page (403) to confirm any free sandbox path.
result.api_notes: SCAPI (Shopper + Admin REST APIs) plus legacy OCAPI. The official MCP page cites nearly 600 Salesforce Commerce API operations.
result.blocker: No self-serve credentials: SLAS and Account Manager API clients require an existing B2C Commerce tenant/instance; Salesforce docs could not be fetched to confirm any free sandbox.
